items.title: Oscar "Chicken" Henry Interview, 1959-07-11
items.q: So he said, you want to use it today? I said, I don't care. We played from 9 o'clock till 6 in the evening on a parade.

ctx.x: So he said to me, Henry, let's see your trombone. I said, all right. Pick it up, and he ran over a scale or two. He said, try mine. I tried this thing. I scratched my head. I said, gee, this thing has some tone to it. So he said, you want to use it today? I said, I don't care. We played from 9 o'clock till 6 in the evening on a parade. The Elks Parade in Cleveland, Ohio, in 26. So I came in. I threw the trombone on the bed, took the mouthpiece, put it in my pocket, walked out, changed chords, and was gone. Next…
No? It's nice. Still in good shape?
